sample.question:
The image shows a six-face cube net. The cube starts with U on top, F in front, and R on the right. A roll north/east/south/west moves the cube in that direction without twisting.
Which emblem is printed on face U?
A. Triangle
B. Bars
C. Sun
D. Circle
E. Cross
F. Diamond
sample.analysis: Locate face U in the unfolded net. Its tile contains the Sun emblem. Therefore the answer is C.
